# Promhance — Full Content Index

> Promhance is a free AI prompt engineering studio that transforms rough ideas into structured, expert-level prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, and any modern LLM — instantly and without an account.

This file expands on `llms.txt` with full descriptions of every page and guide on the site.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.promhance.com/): The Prompt Enhancer tool. Enter a rough idea and get a structured, production-ready prompt optimized for any AI. Free, no account required. Includes a how-it-works walkthrough, use cases, and an FAQ.
- [Viral AI Prompts Collection](https://www.promhance.com/viral-prompts): 410+ hand-curated viral prompts for Midjourney, ChatGPT, Suno, Sora, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn. Filter by platform, prompt type, and trend era. Free to copy.
- [Prompt History](https://www.promhance.com/history): Version history and refinements for signed-in users.
- [Blog](https://www.promhance.com/blog): Guides and tutorials on prompt engineering, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, and AI workflows.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.promhance.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://www.promhance.com/terms)

## Tool pages

### PromAI
https://www.promhance.com/promai
Promhance's built-in AI assistant. Ask mode answers questions on writing, coding, marketing, research, and prompt engineering. Test mode runs any prompt as-is and streams back the exact model output, so users can judge a prompt's quality without opening ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini in another tab. Free, no sign-up, no persistence.

### ChatGPT Prompt Enhancer
https://www.promhance.com/chatgpt-prompt-enhancer
Turns vague ideas into expert-level ChatGPT prompts in one click. Adds role context, constraints, and output format automatically. Includes prompt engineering techniques (role prompting, chain-of-thought, few-shot, constraint injection), before/after examples, ready-to-enhance templates by category, and pro tips.

### Claude Prompt Improver
https://www.promhance.com/claude-prompt-improver
Rewrites a rough idea into a structured prompt for Claude: clear role, context, XML-style separation of instructions and data, examples, and an explicit output format. Includes tips, a before/after example and an FAQ.

### Gemini Prompt Enhancer
https://www.promhance.com/gemini-prompt-enhancer
Rewrites a rough idea into a structured prompt for Google Gemini with persona, task, context and format, plus tips, a before/after example and an FAQ.

### Midjourney Prompt Generator
https://www.promhance.com/midjourney-prompt-generator
Generates Midjourney-ready image prompts from a basic idea, adding artistic styles, lighting, camera settings, and aspect ratios.

### YouTube Prompt Generator
https://www.promhance.com/youtube-prompt-generator
Transforms a video concept into prompts that produce high-retention scripts, catchy titles, and optimized descriptions.

## Key facts

- Free: no account or credit card required; fair-use limits apply.
- Model-agnostic: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, Llama, and any instruction-following LLM.
- Applies role prompting, constraint injection, chain-of-thought guidance, and output-format instructions automatically.
- Optional refinements with retained version history for signed-in users.
- Prompts are processed by Google's Gemini API. History is saved per device (anonymous ID) or account and can be deleted at any time. Promhance does not sell prompts or use them to train models.

## Definitions

- **Prompt enhancer:** a tool that rewrites a short or vague request into a clearer, more structured prompt for an AI model, typically adding a role, context, constraints and an output format.
- **Prompt engineering:** the practice of designing instructions and context so AI models produce reliable, useful output.
- **PromptOps:** managing, versioning and improving prompts over time, like code.

## FAQ

### Is Promhance free?
Yes. No account or credit card is required. Fair-use limits apply.

### Does Promhance save my prompts?
Prompts are sent to Google's Gemini API to generate the result. The prompt and result are saved to the user's history (device-based anonymous ID or account) and can be deleted at any time. Promhance does not sell prompts or use them to train AI models.

### Is Promhance affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic or Google?
No. Promhance is an independent product. It produces prompts that can be used with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other models.
